name: Agent SDK
summary: Build your own agents in Python or TypeScript on the same engine that runs Claude Code.
what: The Claude Agent SDK is a library that gives your application Claude Code's agent loop, built-in tools, permissions, sessions and hooks. You run it in your own process and shape it with options, custom tools and MCP servers.

impact.title: Proven agent loop
impact.detail: Reuse the tools and context handling of Claude Code.

impact.title: Fully programmable
impact.detail: Hooks, permissions and subagents are available in code.

impact.title: Resumable
impact.detail: Sessions can be continued or forked.

howItWorks: Install the SDK for Python or TypeScript and set an API key.
Call it with a prompt and options such as model, tools and permissions.
Add custom tools as in-process MCP tools.
From other languages, run claude -p with --output-format json instead.

events.note: The Claude Code SDK was renamed the Claude Agent SDK.
